summary.en: EPUB, CHM and MHT reader for iPhone and iPad, with search, highlights and notes.
summary.zh: iPhone 与 iPad 的 EPUB、CHM、MHT 阅读器，支持搜索、高亮与笔记。

description.en:
Choose paper backgrounds or dark mode. Adjust fonts, line spacing and margins.

Search across chapters, highlight passages and add notes. Return to any marked passage.

Manage EPUB, CHM and MHT files in one library. Transfer books over local Wi-Fi and read offline.

Start reading for free. If your library grows, a single in-app purchase unlocks an unlimited bookshelf forever.
description.zh:
选择纸张背景或深色模式，调整字体、行距和页边距。

跨章节搜索，为段落添加高亮和笔记，随时返回标记的位置。

在同一书架管理 EPUB、CHM 和 MHT 文件。通过本地 Wi-Fi 传书，离线阅读。

免费开始阅读。藏书渐多时，一次应用内购买，即可永久解锁无限书架。

summary.en: Offline world atlas for iPhone and iPad, with country profiles, a 3D globe and rankings.
summary.zh: iPhone 与 iPad 离线世界地图集，可查国家资料、浏览 3D 地球和比较排名。

description.en: Browse geography, history, people and economy, and compare countries using interactive charts with reported values, dates and ranks. Profiles, flags, rankings, locator maps and the globe work offline. Photos and regional maps require an initial download. Choose from four reading themes. One-time purchase; no in-app purchases, subscriptions, ads or tracking. World Book reads archived CIA World Factbook data; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the CIA. Data is not live, and figures may refer to different years.
description.zh: 查询地理、历史、人口与经济资料，通过交互图表比较各国的数据、记录日期和排名。国家资料、国旗、排名、定位地图与地球支持离线使用，照片和区域地图需先下载。提供四种阅读主题。一次购买，无应用内购买、订阅、广告或追踪。 World Book 读取存档的 CIA World Factbook 资料，与 CIA 无隶属或背书关系。数据不是实时更新，各项指标可能对应不同年份。

summary.en: Install TTF, OTF and TTC fonts on iPhone and iPad for use in compatible apps.
summary.zh: 在 iPhone 与 iPad 安装 TTF、OTF、TTC 字体，供兼容 App 使用。

description.en:
Open your TTF, OTF, TTC, or ZIP files from where you already keep them.

FondFont creates a profile on your device. Allow its download, then finish installation in Settings.

Choose your installed fonts in compatible apps such as Pages, Keynote, Word and PowerPoint.

FondFont creates profiles on your device. Your font files stay on your device. You do not need an account or subscription. It cannot change the iOS system font or add font support to other apps.
description.zh:
从日常存放字体的位置，打开 TTF、OTF、TTC 或 ZIP 文件。

爱装字体在本机生成描述文件。允许下载后，前往「设置」完成安装。

在支持 iOS 字体库的 App 中选择已安装字体，例如 Pages、Keynote、Word 和 PowerPoint。

爱装字体在本机生成描述文件。字体文件不会上传。无需账号或订阅。 不能修改 iOS 系统字体，也不能让不支持字体库的 App 使用字体。

summary.en: English text refinement on Mac, with explanations, examples and optional iPhone review.
summary.zh: Mac 英语润色工具，提供解释与例句，可选在 iPhone 上复习。

description.en:
Capture new input from AI coding tools without interrupting your work. Type Chinese, English or both. Refine a selection or the current text field in another app. Focused notes and examples. Ask follow-up questions about a record on your Mac. US or UK English; natural, casual or professional. Choose the explanation language and keep your tone. Browse by date, bookmark, copy and reuse. Retry failures or delete records you no longer need. Optional iCloud sync · iPhone TestFlight beta. Read aloud, practise recall, set daily reminders or continue in an AI app.

Local records by default; you opt into iCloud. English generation still uses the selected AI service. Filters low-value input and redacts high-confidence secrets. Preserves code, paths and URLs. Mac follow-up chats stay local and are neither synced nor exported. Delete cloud data separately while keeping Mac records.
description.zh:
自动捕捉 AI 编程工具中的新输入，不打断手头的事。 直接写中文、英文或混合句；也能快捷润色其他 App 的选区或输入框。 重点笔记配例句。在 Mac 上围绕这条记录继续追问。 美式或英式，自然、轻松或专业；自选讲解语言，也可保留原有语气。 日历找回、收藏重点、复制复用；失败可重试，不需要的记录随时删。 可选 iCloud 同步 · iPhone TestFlight 测试版。朗读、记忆复习、每日提醒，也能转交 AI 继续问。

记录默认本地保存；iCloud 同步由你开启。生成英语仍会使用所选 AI 服务。 过滤低价值输入，识别并遮盖高置信度密钥；代码、路径和网址保留原样。 Mac 追问仅存在本机，不同步、不导出。可单独删除云端数据，保留 Mac 记录。
